flashcard_questions.q: How do the plates move at a constructive plate boundary?
flashcard_questions.a: They move apart, so magma rises to fill the gap and forms new crust.

flashcard_questions.q: Which type of volcano forms at a constructive plate boundary?
flashcard_questions.a: A wide, gently sloping shield volcano.

flashcard_questions.q: Which country sits directly on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge?

flashcard_questions.a: The denser oceanic plate being forced beneath a less dense continental plate.

flashcard_questions.q: Which type of volcano forms at a destructive plate boundary?
Which oceanic plate is being subducted beneath the South American Plate?
How do the plates move at a conservative plate boundary?
flashcard_questions.a: They slide past each other, either in opposite directions or at different speeds.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do no volcanoes form at a conservative plate boundary?
flashcard_questions.a: No magma reaches the surface there.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Californian fault is the best-known conservative plate boundary?
Which landform is created where two continental plates collide?
Which two plates collided to form the Himalayas?
flashcard_questions.a: The Indian Plate and the Eurasian Plate.

flashcard_questions.q: How much do the Himalayas grow each year?
How many people live within 60 miles of an active or dormant volcano?
Why does volcanic ash attract farmers to settle near volcanoes?
flashcard_questions.a: It breaks down into extremely fertile soil, ideal for growing crops.

flashcard_questions.q: Which mineral do workers mine inside the crater of Mount Ijen?

notes: 15 cards: 4 process-to-landform (constructive movement, shield volcano, composite volcano, fold mountains), 3 term-to-definition or explanation (subduction, conservative movement, no volcanoes at conservative), 4 case-study-to-fact with one figure or name each (Iceland, Nazca Plate, San Andreas, Himalaya plates), 2 cloze-style statistics (1 cm growth, 750 million people), 2 strategy-to-example on why people stay (fertile soil, Mount Ijen sulphur). Dropped the Pacific Plate speed and Iceland geothermal cards to keep the deck at 15.
